steps.evidence: General  procedure  B  was  applied  to  7-bromo-2-methylquinoline  (222mg,  1.00mmol).
The  reaction  was stirred at room temperaturefor 48 hours
Purification  by  silica  gel  flash-column  chromatography  with  gradient  elution  of  MeOH/DCM  from  0.5 -12.5%   over   25   column   volumes

uncertainties: General procedure B is referenced but not supplied; its additional reagents, quantities, operations, and conditions cannot be reconstructed.
Room temperature is qualitative; no numerical temperature or stirring rate is reported.
The percentage basis of the MeOH/DCM gradient is not explicitly stated.
No additional eluent composition, volume, or duration is reported for the further elution.
The reported mixture of 2 monoborylated isomers in an 80:20 ratio is an observation, not an additional synthesis action.

The major-product observations are: 7-bromo-2-methyl-4-(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-[1,3,2]dioxaborolan-2-yl)quinoline; white solid; 225 mg; 65%; Rf 0.1; melting point 149–150 °C. These are not synthesis actions.

The further-elution product observations are: 7-bromo-2-methyl-5-(4,4,5,5-tetramethyl-[1,3,2]dioxaborolan-2-yl)quinoline; white solid; 52 mg; 15%; Rf 0.05; melting point 151–152 °C. These are not synthesis actions.
